Dear webpage  team,
Hi! XX, a representative of Lawyerd! - a fully automated platform for intellectual property (IP) protection. As a fellow startup, we understand how it is important to protect your product and show the protection level for investors.
 
Our technology allows you to certify your object of IP rights (design, software, pictures, content, etc.) monitors and protects your digital assets 24/7 and worldwide, allowing you to delete copyright violations in just 5 seconds, without the burden of expensive legal fees and stacks of paper. We know from our 10+ years of experience in IP protection how to do it simple and fast. 
We are protecting clients products from the time of creation till successful realization on the market.
 
I am contacting you because we looked through your site webpage.com  and want to emphasize that you are a great startup with a powerful product that has to be protected.
Please do not hesitate to contact me, if you want to get one free certificate that proves the rights of your product and 40% discount for future certificates with promocode COPYRIGHT40.
We would be happy to learn more about your IP issues and show you how easy it could be to deal with them with a demo. 
 
Our presentation deck is here: 
Lawyerd! Sales Deck (Startups)
 

Looking forward to getting to know you and learning more about your IP issues.
Please feel free to contact me if you have any questions:
https://company.youcanbook.me
https://t.me/companysupport
email@domain.com

Best regards,
